description: This file defines a React component named `EvaluationGraph` that renders a canvas-based, interactive evaluation-over-time graph for a chess analysis interface. It includes various helper functions for color parsing, coordinate calculations, and rendering logic, as well as hooks to handle responsiveness and user interactions.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Helper to constrain a number within min and max bounds.

methods.name: pxNumber
methods.description: Extracts a float from a CSS pixel value string, with fallback.

methods.name: toRgba
methods.description: Converts various CSS color formats to an rgba() string with specified alpha.

methods.name: computeYRange
methods.description: Calculates the min and max for y-axis scaling, with clamping for extreme values.

methods.name: xForIndex
methods.description: Maps a ply index to an x-coordinate on the canvas.

methods.name: yForValue
methods.description: Maps a evaluation value to a y-coordinate on the canvas.

methods.name: roundRect
methods.description: Draws a rounded rectangle on canvas for stylish backgrounds.
